dialog.check: I checked that the reference details are correct
dialog.duplicate: A paper with the same DOI is already in your library.

dialog.candidates: Reference details found · choose the matching one

notes.pdf-no-text: Could not extract text from the PDF. If it is a scan, search by DOI or title.
notes.no-doi: No DOI was found. Search by title or enter the details.
notes.provider-error: Some reference services did not respond.
notes.not-found: No matching reference details were found. Enter them yourself.

dialog.retracted: This paper has a retraction record. Check the retraction notice before adding it.
dialog.corrected: This paper has a correction record.
dialog.importDone: Added {added} papers. Skipped {duplicates} already in your library.
dialog.importFailed: Could not read the bibliography file. Check its format.

zotero.title: Zotero
zotero.webKeyHint: A key made under Security in zotero.org settings. A read-only key imports only; sending to Zotero also needs write access. The key is not shown again.
zotero.ok: Connected via {connection, select, local {Zotero on this PC} other {web key}} · updated {when}
zotero.notSynced: Connected via {connection, select, local {Zotero on this PC} other {web key}} · not updated yet

states.zotero-closed: Zotero is not running on this PC. Open the Zotero app, then update again.
states.local-api-off: In Zotero Settings → Advanced, turn on "Allow other applications to communicate", then connect again.
states.key-rejected: Zotero refused the connection. Check the web key's permissions or the Zotero approval prompt.
states.key-invalid: Zotero rejected the web key. It was deleted or mistyped. Check the key under Security in zotero.org settings, then save a new key.
states.no-library-access: The web key cannot read your personal library. Turn on "Allow library access" for the key under Security in zotero.org settings, then update again.
states.library-not-found: Zotero could not find the library. Check which account made the web key, then save a new key.
states.rate-limited: Zotero is limiting requests. Wait several minutes, then update again.
states.server-error: The Zotero server did not respond. Update again in a moment.
states.library-changing: The Zotero library kept changing during the update. Finish editing in Zotero, then update again.
states.certificate-untrusted: The institute network relays the Zotero connection, and GAID does not trust its security certificate, so it could not connect. Set the institute certificate file in `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`, then restart GAID.
states.unreachable: Could not connect to Zotero. Check the network connection, then update again.
states.failed: Could not read the Zotero library. If updating again fails the same way, copy the technical details and pass them on.

zotero.hint: Papers collected in Zotero appear in the library too. GAID writes to Zotero only when you send papers or add them to a linked folder.
zotero.failed: Connected via {connection, select, local {Zotero on this PC} other {web key}} · update failed
zotero.failedSince: Connected via {connection, select, local {Zotero on this PC} other {web key}} · update failed · last updated {when}
zotero.localNote: Zotero on this PC updates only while the Zotero app is running. Papers from the last update stay in the library when the app is closed.
zotero.emptyWeb: The zotero.org web library has no papers. A web key reads only papers the Zotero app has synced to zotero.org. To see papers in Zotero on this PC, disconnect the web key, then connect Zotero on this PC.

disconnect.hint: Papers already in the library stay after you disconnect. The web key is deleted.

send.failed: Could not send to Zotero. Check the Zotero connection.
send.confirm: When Zotero asks for approval, choose "Always Allow".
send.nothing: There was nothing new to send.
send.stopped: Zotero refused the next write, so sending stopped. Sent: {done}. Choose "Always Allow" in Zotero's approval window, then send again.

read.failed: Could not extract text from the PDF.

references.title: References
references.unknown: Not in your library · check this citation key

folders.title: Folders
folders.empty: No folders yet. Make one per topic or manuscript.
folders.linkedHint: Linked to a Zotero collection. Rename or move it in Zotero.

new.title: New folder
new.subTitle: New folder in {parent}
new.hint: A paper can be in several folders.
new.label: Folder name
new.failed: The folder was not created. Check the name and try again.

folders.addFailed: The paper was not added. Try again.
folders.removeInZotero: This paper is in the Zotero collection. Remove it in Zotero; GAID follows.
folders.emptyFolder: No papers in the folder. Drag papers from the table onto it, or add them from the paper details.

folder.linked: Folder linked to a Zotero collection
folder.linkedRule: For Zotero papers, folder membership follows Zotero. Adding a paper in GAID also adds it to the Zotero collection.

delete.title: Delete folder {name}
delete.body: Its subfolders are deleted too. The papers stay in the library.

cite.title: Citations
cite.body: Collect the papers a manuscript cites in a folder. Export and the reference check include subfolders.

attach.hint: Research notes and the AI agent of the attached project cite from the folder's papers.
attach.toast: Attached to the citation scope of {name}
attach.failed: The folder was not attached. Try again.

check.failed: The check did not run. Try again.
check.none: Nothing to fix found in {n} papers.

zotero.title: Zotero
zotero.body: Creates the folder and its subfolders as Zotero collections and sends the GAID papers with their PDFs.
zotero.linkedBody: Sends papers and PDFs not yet in Zotero to the linked Zotero collection.
zotero.offline: Connect Zotero to send the folder to Zotero.

send.title: Send folder {name} to Zotero
send.body: Sends {n} papers. A paper already in Zotero is not created again; it is only added to the collection. When Zotero asks for approval, choose "Always Allow".

map.pickTitle: Project to open the map in
